field.name: exEntityID
field.comment: The ID of the Express entity whose entries are listed

field.name: detailPage
field.comment: The ID of the page that displays the details of an entry, linked by the columns listed in linkedProperties (0: no link)

field.name: linkedProperties
field.comment: A JSON array of the IDs of the attributes of the entity whose columns link to the detailPage page

field.name: searchProperties
field.comment: A JSON array of the IDs of the attributes of the entity the visitors can search the entries by (used if enableSearch is true)

field.name: searchAssociations
field.comment: A JSON array of the IDs of the associations of the entity the visitors can search the entries by (used if enableSearch is true)

field.name: columns
field.comment: The columns of the table, as the PHP serialization of the column set holding them and the column the entries are sorted by

field.name: filterFields
field.comment: The filters the entries must match, as the PHP serialization of the search fields holding them

field.name: displayLimit
field.comment: How many entries a page displays

field.name: enableItemsPerPageSelection
field.comment: true: the visitors can choose how many entries a page displays; false or NULL: they are stuck with displayLimit

field.name: enablePagination
field.comment: true: the visitors can move to the other pages of the list; false or NULL: only the first page is reachable

field.name: enableSearch
field.comment: true: the visitors are offered a form to search the entries, unless there is nothing to search by; false or NULL: they are not

field.name: enableKeywordSearch
field.comment: true: the form to search the entries accepts keywords too; false or NULL: it doesn't (used if enableSearch is true)

field.name: headerBackgroundColor
field.comment: The background color of the header of the table, as a CSS color such as rgb(255, 0, 0)

field.name: headerBackgroundColorActiveSort
field.comment: The background color of the column of the header the entries are sorted by, as a CSS color such as rgb(255, 0, 0)

field.name: headerTextColor
field.comment: The color of the text of the header of the table, as a CSS color such as rgb(255, 0, 0)

field.name: tableName
field.comment: The title displayed above the table

field.name: tableDescription
field.comment: The text displayed below the title of the table

field.name: tableStriped
field.comment: true: the rows of the table alternate two colors, the second one being rowBackgroundColorAlternate; false or NULL: they all look the same

field.name: rowBackgroundColorAlternate
field.comment: The color of the even rows of the table, as a CSS color such as rgb(255, 0, 0) (used if tableStriped is true)

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the title of the table: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p
